tasks.title: Initialize Project Repository and Tooling
tasks.description: Set up a version-controlled project repository with modern frontend tooling and enforce code quality standards.
tasks.details: Create a Git repository. Use Node.js (LTS, v20+) and npm. Initialize with Vite (v5+) for fast development and build. Configure ESLint (v9+) and Prettier for code quality. Add Husky for pre-commit hooks. Set up .editorconfig and .gitignore. Choose MIT license.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify repository setup, run lint and format scripts, ensure pre-commit hooks block bad code.

tasks.title: Design and Implement Project Structure
tasks.description: Establish a scalable, organized file and folder structure for the portfolio website.
tasks.details: Follow atomic design principles. Create src/components, src/pages, src/assets, src/data, and src/utils. Use PascalCase for components. Document structure in README. Use TypeScript for type safety.
tasks.testStrategy: Check for logical organization, adherence to naming conventions, and TypeScript compilation.

tasks.title: Setup Core UI Framework and Styling
tasks.description: Integrate a modern UI framework and global styling system.
tasks.details: Install React (v18+), React Router (v6+), and Tailwind CSS (v3.4+). Configure Tailwind with custom theme for branding. Add PostCSS and autoprefixer. Set up global styles and CSS reset. Use CSS variables for color and typography.
tasks.testStrategy: Render sample components, verify Tailwind classes and custom theme, check responsive breakpoints.

tasks.title: Implement Navigation System
tasks.description: Develop an intuitive, accessible navigation bar and breadcrumb system.
tasks.details: Use React Router for SPA navigation. Build a top navigation bar with clear CTAs: About, Portfolio, Contact, Resume. Add breadcrumbs for subpages. Ensure keyboard navigation and ARIA roles for accessibility. Follow 'One-Click Rule' for key content.
tasks.testStrategy: Test navigation on desktop and mobile, validate ARIA roles, check tab order and focus states.

tasks.title: Develop Case Study Templates and Data Model
tasks.description: Create reusable templates and data structures for case studies.
tasks.details: Define a TypeScript interface for project metadata (title, client, date, skills, deliverables, images, description). Build a CaseStudy component with sections for overview, process, outcomes, and gallery. Store case study data as JSON or MDX for easy updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Render multiple case studies with different data, validate schema, check for missing fields.

tasks.title: Automated Image Processing Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement automated image optimization and organization.
tasks.details: Use Sharp (v0.33+) for server-side image resizing and compression. Integrate with npm scripts for batch processing. Store images in src/assets/images with naming conventions. Generate WebP and fallback JPEG/PNG. Add alt text metadata.
tasks.testStrategy: Process sample images, check output sizes and formats, verify alt text presence, run Lighthouse performance audit.

tasks.title: Build Portfolio Gallery with Filtering and Lightbox
tasks.description: Create a gallery to showcase projects with filtering and lightbox features.
tasks.details: Use React and Framer Motion for smooth animations. Implement filtering by client, project type, and skills. Integrate React Photo Gallery (v8+) and React-Modal for lightbox. Ensure keyboard and screen reader accessibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test filtering logic, open/close lightbox, check accessibility, verify image quality and performance.

tasks.title: Implement About Page and Skills Visualization
tasks.description: Develop an About page with professional background and a visual skills showcase.
tasks.details: Create AboutPage component with structured sections: bio, experience, certifications. Use React Simple Bar Chart or D3.js for skills visualization. Ensure responsive layout and accessible color contrast.
tasks.testStrategy: Render About page on all devices, validate chart accessibility, check for content clarity.

tasks.title: Develop Contact Form with Validation and Email Integration
tasks.description: Create a professional contact form with validation and backend email delivery.
tasks.details: Use React Hook Form (v7+) for form state and validation. Integrate with EmailJS or a serverless function (e.g., Vercel/Netlify Functions) for email delivery. Add spam protection (honeypot + reCAPTCHA v3). Store submissions in a secure backend (e.g., Firebase or Supabase, optional).
tasks.testStrategy: Submit valid/invalid forms, check email delivery, test spam protection, verify accessibility.

tasks.title: Resume Download and Asset Delivery
tasks.description: Enable secure, accessible downloads for resume and project deliverables.
tasks.details: Store resume and assets in public directory or CDN. Use signed URLs for sensitive files if needed. Add download buttons with clear labels and ARIA attributes. Track downloads via analytics.
tasks.testStrategy: Download files on all devices, check file integrity, validate accessibility and analytics events.

tasks.title: Responsive Design and Mobile Optimization
tasks.description: Ensure a mobile-first, fully responsive layout across all pages and components.
tasks.details: Use Tailwind's responsive utilities and CSS grid/flexbox. Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile, Samsung Internet. Optimize touch targets and font sizes. Use Lighthouse and BrowserStack for device testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test on multiple devices and browsers, run Lighthouse mobile audit, check for layout issues.

tasks.title: Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) Compliance
tasks.description: Implement and verify accessibility features for inclusive design.
tasks.details: Use semantic HTML, ARIA roles, and keyboard navigation. Ensure color contrast, alt text, focus indicators, and skip links. Test with axe-core and Lighthouse. Provide accessible labels for all interactive elements.
tasks.testStrategy: Run automated accessibility tests, perform manual keyboard and screen reader checks, fix violations.

tasks.title: Performance Optimization (Lazy Loading, Caching, CDN)
tasks.description: Optimize site performance for fast loading and high Lighthouse scores.
tasks.details: Implement lazy loading for images (native loading='lazy' and React LazyLoad). Use Vite's code splitting. Configure HTTP caching headers. Deploy static assets to CDN (e.g., Cloudflare). Monitor with WebPageTest and Google PageSpeed Insights.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure load times, Lighthouse performance score, verify lazy loading and CDN delivery.

tasks.title: SEO and Structured Data Implementation
tasks.description: Add SEO meta tags, Open Graph, and structured data for discoverability.
tasks.details: Use React Helmet Async for dynamic meta tags. Add JSON-LD structured data for projects and person schema. Optimize titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs. Generate sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Test with Google Search Console.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate with Lighthouse SEO audit, test rich results in Google, check sitemap and robots.txt.

tasks.title: Analytics and User Engagement Tracking
tasks.description: Integrate analytics to monitor portfolio engagement and user flows.
tasks.details: Use Plausible Analytics (privacy-friendly) or Google Analytics 4. Track page views, downloads, contact submissions, and filter usage. Add event tracking for key interactions. Ensure GDPR compliance (cookie consent if needed).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify analytics events fire correctly, check dashboard for real-time data, test opt-out functionality.
